requirements.title: CLI command parity
requirements.description: CLI wrapper commands matching all API functionality (status, diff, stage, unstage, commit, health)

requirements.title: Baselines pin one immutable comprehensive Test Genie run
requirements.description: The baseline API and CLI persist a schema-versioned single-run anchor, pass every Test Genie phase diff through without a local phase registry, separate behavioral blockers from advisory staleness/enrichment failures, migrate same-run V1 manifests idempotently, reject mixed-run manifests with repair guidance, and pin or unpin the run exactly once.

validation.notes: TestServiceCapturePersistsOneRichRunAnchor and TestFinalizeCaptureIsIdempotentUnderConcurrentRecovery cover new captures; TestServiceLegacyMigrationReconcilesRetentionPinOnce, TestServiceLegacyMigrationPinFailureRemainsRetryable, and TestServiceListReconcilesEveryLegacyRetentionPin cover crash-safe exactly-once migration retention; TestCopiedBaselineMigrationRehearsal applies the same path twice to copied real manifests; TestServiceForwardsUnknownPhaseAndOpaqueArtifacts covers lossless dynamic evidence.
Covers stable same-run migration plus mixed, empty, partial, skipped, corrupt, already-V2, and concurrent migrate/delete cases.
Fails if fixed Test Genie phase routing returns and preserves unknown phase descriptors and typed reasons losslessly.
Proves empty-create and per-surface edit commands are absent from the CLI.
Auxiliary catalog and visual outages mark evidence incomplete without overwriting an authoritative behavioral verdict.

requirements.title: Baseline waits detach without changing durable outcomes
requirements.description: Snapshot, collection capture, and diff intents remain pending when an attachment times out or is canceled; independent children reattach concurrently; terminal cache state is never fabricated from transport failure; and every incomplete wait returns typed exit 3 recovery by the existing durable identity without starting duplicate work.

validation.notes: Proves capture/diff attachment deadlines leave pending intents and no terminal cache or pin side effect.
Proves one blocking read plus one non-blocking recovery read on EOF, with no retry for ordinary inspect or non-EOF errors.
Proves bounded concurrent collection reattachment and typed pending identities on cancellation.
Proves collection capture and diff waits return exit 3 and one durable recovery command while incomplete.

requirements.title: Git-aware bounded informational source evidence
requirements.description: Path-snapshot estimates and captures use tracked plus non-ignored untracked Git candidates by default, retain only metadata unless content retention is explicit, and return deterministic scope-repair guidance before source evidence can start behavioral collection work.

validation.notes: Covers ignored dependency filtering, explicit ignored opt-in, individual-scenario safety, and generated-output repair guidance.
Covers metadata-only default and explicit retained-content quota preflight.
